description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Own the design and full-stack build of a customer-facing web application, partnering directly with company founders. The work spans interface design, engineering, release and go-to-market content, shaped by usage data and customer input.
 What you'll do
 - Build and maintain a web application across front end and back end, using TypeScript and Python.
 - Design clear, polished interfaces that make complex systems easy to use.
 - Carry each feature from early customer discovery and prototypes all the way to release.
 - Create demos, release materials and promotional campaigns for what you ship.
 - Maintain high standards for design quality, performance and delivery speed.
 - Use product analytics and customer feedback to prioritize upcoming work.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - At least 3 years of full-stack engineering experience.
 - Solid UI and UX skills, with strong product judgment and care for detail.
 - A track record of launching a brand-new product from scratch.
 - Hands-on experience building with large language models and agent-based systems.
 - Clear writing and a good instinct for how to position and promote a product.
 - Self-directed approach, able to spot problems and resolve them without supervision.
 - Existing US work authorization.
 Bonus points
 - Past founder or early-stage startup engineering background.
 - Exposure to tools built for developers or AI-first applications.
 - Familiarity with agent orchestration or SDK design.
 - Background in creating video walkthroughs, demos or technical write-ups.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 150,000 to 300,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - Remote (US)
 - Full-time
